faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Ceramic Heater Clamp Plate suitable for Ceramic heater core clamping plate?
faq.a: Titanium Ceramic Heater Clamp Plate uses Grade 2 CP-Ti because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address chamber shield operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Ceramic Heater Clamp Plate?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Ceramic Heater Clamp Plate is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for ceramic heater core requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Ceramic Heater Clamp Plate require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. ceramic heater core components require Electropolishing Ra <0.25um + UHP DI cascade rinse with particle count verification per MIL-STD-1246 Class 1 — tailored for ceramic heater core application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Ceramic Heater Clamp Plate shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium Ceramic Heater Clamp Plate includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet ceramic heater core specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.

faq.q: What is the MOQ and typical lead time for Heater clamp / Ceramic clamp chamber shield components?
faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
